dialogues.jp:
テスト当日の登校風景というものは、まことに
面白いものだ。
dialogues.en:
The morning of the day of exams is always an interesting
sight.
dialogues.text:
The morning of the day of exams is always an interesting
sight.

dialogues.jp:
参考書片手に青い顔で歩き、あわや電柱にぶつ
かりそうになる者あり。
dialogues.en:
Students everywhere were holding a textbook in one hand,
with black rings around their eyes.
dialogues.text:
Students everywhere were holding a textbook in one hand,
with black rings around their eyes.

dialogues.jp:
また、すべてを諦めたのか捨て鉢なほど明るい
笑顔の者あり。
dialogues.en:
Those who weren't, were simply smiling brightly, having
obviously given up.
dialogues.text:
Those who weren't, were simply smiling brightly, having
obviously given up.

dialogues.jp:
まわりから見たら、俺などはさしづめ後者なの
だろうが……。
dialogues.en: I guess I would fall in the latter category...
dialogues.text: I guess I would fall in the latter category...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あ、おはよう」
dialogues.en: "Ah, good afternoon."
dialogues.text: "Ah, good afternoon."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「よぉ」
dialogues.en: "Yo."
dialogues.text: "Yo."

dialogues.jp: そんな学生達のなかから、工藤が現れた。
dialogues.en: Kudou appeared from within the crowd of students.
dialogues.text: Kudou appeared from within the crowd of students.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、調子はどうだ？」
dialogues.en: "How goes the exam preparations, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "How goes the exam preparations, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……俺に聞くなよ」
dialogues.en: "...I didn't hear anything."
dialogues.text: "...I didn't hear anything."

dialogues.jp: …………はー。今日も空が青い。
dialogues.en: .....Haaa~, today's sky is so blue.
dialogues.text: .....Haaa~, today's sky is so blue.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よぉ、二人とも」
dialogues.en: "Yo, you two."
dialogues.text: "Yo, you two."

dialogues.jp:
そんな青い空よりもさわやかそうに、笑顔の男
が登場した。
dialogues.en:
With a smile as radiant as the blue sky, another student
made his appearance.
dialogues.text:
With a smile as radiant as the blue sky, another student
made his appearance.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだなんだ？　元気がないな」
dialogues.en: "Hm hmm? Feeling down today?"
dialogues.text: "Hm hmm? Feeling down today?"

dialogues.jp: ……いや、お前が色々と特殊なんだと思うが。
dialogues.en: ...Ever thought it had something to do with you?
dialogues.text: ...Ever thought it had something to do with you?

dialogues.jp:
俺達の心境を察したのか、杉並はからからと笑
い声をたてた。
dialogues.en:
Not able to hear the words from my mind, Suginami continued
with his wry grin.
dialogues.text:
Not able to hear the words from my mind, Suginami continued
with his wry grin.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ははぁ、テストの心配か？　よせよせ、答案
　を見もしないうちから悩んでてどうする」
dialogues.en:
"Haha, worried about the test? Don't bother, there's nothing
you can do till the paper's in front of you!"
dialogues.text:
"Haha, worried about the test? Don't bother, there's nothing
you can do till the paper's in front of you!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ネガティブな気持ちじゃ何事も上手くいかな
　いぞ」
dialogues.en: "Thinking negatively now will only make it worse later."
dialogues.text: "Thinking negatively now will only make it worse later."

dialogues.jp:
なるほど正しい意見ではある。ではあるが……
それは何の不安もない立場だからこそ吐ける台
詞だろう……。
dialogues.en:
That is pretty logical advice... But of course, it's coming
from someone who shouldn't have any worries about it
dialogues.text:
That is pretty logical advice... But of course, it's coming
from someone who shouldn't have any worries about it

dialogues.jp: （まったく……不公平な世の中だぜ）
dialogues.en: "(Pah... the world is so unfair.)"
dialogues.text: "(Pah... the world is so unfair.)"

dialogues.jp: ま、恨み言を言っても仕方ない。
dialogues.en: Oh well, no point in being resentful.
dialogues.text: Oh well, no point in being resentful.

dialogues.jp:
こういうのは結局、自分の実力範囲内で頑張る
しかないんだからな……。
dialogues.en:
After all, I'd find out the true extent of my capabilities
from here on...
dialogues.text:
After all, I'd find out the true extent of my capabilities
from here on...

dialogues.jp: ◆テスト当日◆
dialogues.en: ◆Day of Tests◆
dialogues.text: ◆Day of Tests◆

dialogues.jp:
テスト当日。もう半ば諦め気分の俺が工藤と話
していると、能天気な杉並登場。
dialogues.en:
On the day of the tests, I was talking to Kudou in a
half-defeated state, when Suginami came by.
dialogues.text:
On the day of the tests, I was talking to Kudou in a
half-defeated state, when Suginami came by.

dialogues.jp:
その余裕の発言っぷりに。不公平な世の中をし
みじみと感じたのだった。
dialogues.en: His easy demeanour really shows how unfair this world is.
dialogues.text: His easy demeanour really shows how unfair this world is.

dialogues.jp: …まぁ、それでもやるしかないか。
dialogues.en: ...Well, I'd just have to do my best anyway.
dialogues.text: ...Well, I'd just have to do my best anyway.
